sloka: मा कृथास्तनुसन्तापं मत्कृते ऽपि नरर्षभ ।कृतान्तः कुशलः पुत्र येनास्मि व्यसनीकृतः ।। ७.५४.१५ ॥
transliteration: mā kṛthāstanusantāpaṁ matkṛte 'pi nararṣabha ।kṛtāntaḥ kuśalaḥ putra yenāsmi vyasanīkṛtaḥ ।। 7.54.15 ॥

translations.english: O best of men, do not grieve for my sake, O son, for destiny is powerful, and it is by its force that I have been afflicted with this misery.
